description: This PHP class defines the S3TablesClient, a client for interacting with the Amazon S3 Tables service, including methods for managing namespaces, tables, buckets, policies, and configurations.

classes.name: S3TablesClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, customized for Amazon S3 Tables service interactions.

methods.name: createNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new namespace in the S3 Tables service.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the specified namespace.

methods.name: createTableBucket
methods.description: Creates a backup bucket for a table.

methods.name: deleteTableBucketAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a table's backup bucket.

methods.name: deleteTableBucketPolicy
methods.description: Deletes the policy of a table's backup bucket.

methods.name: deleteTableBucketPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the backup bucket policy.

methods.name: deleteTablePolicy
methods.description: Deletes the policy of a table.

methods.name: getTableBucket
methods.description: Gets information about a table's backup bucket.

methods.name: getTableBucketMaintenanceConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the maintenance configuration for a table's backup bucket.

methods.name: getTableBucketPolicy
methods.description: Gets the policy of a table's backup bucket.

methods.name: getTableMaintenanceConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves maintenance configuration for a table.

methods.name: getTableMaintenanceJobStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of a table's maintenance job.

methods.name: getTableMetadataLocation
methods.description: Fetches the metadata location for a table.

methods.name: getTablePolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the policy associated with a table.

methods.name: putTableBucketMaintenanceConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the maintenance configuration for a table's backup bucket.

methods.name: putTableBucketMaintenanceConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets backup bucket maintenance configuration.

methods.name: putTableBucketPolicy
methods.description: Sets the policy for a table's backup bucket.

methods.name: putTableMaintenanceConfiguration
methods.description: Configures maintenance settings for a table.

methods.name: putTablePolicy
methods.description: Sets the policy for a table.

methods.name: updateTableMetadataLocation
methods.description: Updates the metadata location for a table.
